title: The Quartermaster's Pension Ledger
logline: An aging hospice quartermaster hires a pilot to smuggle confiscated dialysis filters past a municipal auditor before the ward's life-support ration is repossessed.

roles.description: Runs the supply room at a deteriorating orbital veterans' sanatorium; frail, stubborn, quietly skimming dead pilots' stipends to buy medical parts.
Station financial liquidator assigned to close the deficit in the veterans' hospice budget.
An armed municipal cutter sent to clamp the hospice's external supply pods.
The underfunded mutual aid society supporting retired cargo pilots and void-hand veterans.
A cold, cramped supply depot behind the hospice wards filled with salvaged life-support canisters.
The station administrative registry where veteran benefit allowances are approved and audited.

public_situation: {role:municipal_auditor} freezes the supply accounts of {role:veterans_sanatorium}, alleging systematic benefit fraud across the retired pilot wards.
private_truth: {role:hospice_quartermaster} kept six deceased pilots logged as active patients to channel their pensions into black-market dialysis cartridges for the remaining twelve bedridden veterans.

beats.public_change: Municipal bailiffs establish a checkpoint outside {role:quartermaster_store}, halting deliveries of uncertified medical equipment.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to purchase synthetic renal dialyzers at the station exchange and deliver them to the hospice storeroom before accounts freeze.
missions.private_fact: He forged the deceased wing commander's signature on the purchase vouchers to release the funds.

beats.public_change: {role:municipal_auditor} requests outside forensic review after identifying duplicate patient pension numbers in hospital registers.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to scan the hospice auxiliary intake logs and identify discrepancies between registered patients and medical supply deliveries.
missions.private_fact: Her promotion to municipal comptroller depends on recovering eighty thousand credits in hospice overpayments.

beats.public_change: {role:bailiff_skiff} takes position over the sanatorium's external life-support pods, preparing to sever auxiliary oxygen conduits.

missions.reason: He needs the auditor's repo skiff disabled before bailiffs board the hospice storage pylon to seize the life-support filters.
missions.private_fact: The skiff skipper hails offering a municipal clearance bounty and immunity if the pilot surrenders the storeroom keys.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the bailiff skiff and protects the supply delivery.
resolutions.summary: The dialyzers keep the surviving veterans alive. {role:hospice_quartermaster} is placed under quiet municipal house arrest while {role:veterans_sanatorium} retains its beds.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot disabled a municipal bailiff skiff in docking orbit to keep life-support dialyzers flowing to a dying veterans' ward.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the bailiff settlement and hands over storeroom access.
resolutions.summary: Municipal bailiffs impound the storeroom. The pension fraud is halted, and the bedridden veterans of {role:veterans_sanatorium} are relocated to crowded municipal charity barracks.

consequences.public_summary: Hospice staff say an independent pilot collected a municipal finders fee while bailiffs emptied the sanatorium's medicine lockers.

resolutions.reached_by: Deliveries fail or forensic scans expose the hospice without defensive intervention.
resolutions.summary: Municipal freezes halt life-support supplies. {role:veterans_sanatorium} shutters its hospice wing and disperses its bedridden patients into underfunded transit shelters.

loose_threads.detail: The seized medical cases are wrapped in cargo waybills billed to a freight captain who vanished twenty-two years ago.
A municipal debt recovery board posted a bounty for hospice ledger assets matching the auditor's personal commission tier.
The bailiff skiff hull displays registration stencils previously assigned to a private collection firm.

radio_hooks: Municipal comptroller announces comprehensive audit of long-term medical benefit subsidies.
Veterans sanatorium issues urgent appeal for voluntary synthetic life-support contributions.
Station administration reminds tenants that unlicensed pharmaceuticals are subject to confiscation.

voice_direction.hospice_quartermaster: Dry, raspy, and halting. Speaks with the defensive fatigue of someone who has argued with station clerks for thirty years and no longer expects courtesy.
voice_direction.municipal_auditor: Crisp, fast, and relentlessly polite. Uses sterile administrative euphemisms to describe evicting bedridden hospice patients.
